In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, each “requires X” example stubs only one setting and leaves the others at their defaults from config/site_settings.yml (`feed_polling_url: ''`, `embed_by_username: ''`). Because `''.present?` is false, `poll_feed` would not be called even if the specific condition under test were removed, so these negative gate tests don’t actually verify each individual gate.
